card.name: Word before a noun in old-style prose
card.fires_on: Small words (be, still, that, above, 's) or adjectives (important, naval, distinctive) that sit just before an expected noun in archaic or historical prose. Mostly history and web text, not drug labels.

modes.label: Linking or helper word
modes.description: A verb or small word mid-clause in formal historical prose, where a participle or noun follows.

modes.label: Adjective before a noun
modes.description: A modifier right before a noun such as fortress, port or mark.
modes.example: and saved that<< important>> fortress to the Union.

card.writes: It suppresses the word "current" and its variants, and weakly promotes unrelated word starts.
card.plain: It fires on small modifying words in old historical writing, just before the noun they describe.
